abilities.name: Sacrifice
abilities.description: Channel the Cardinal’s own vitality to one ally as an outward crimson stream and a gentle gold receiving glow.

cast.description: Soft heartbeat and ethereal outward life-force whoosh, immediate divine connection.

impact.description: Gentle golden healing chime with a warm breath of restoration at the receiving ally.

sustain.description: Seamless calm heartbeat and ethereal life-stream hum, subdued and warm.

notes: Canonical IDheal comes from heal.md, whose displayed ability name isSacrifice.
Life travels FROM Cardinal TO ally; not generic free healing.
No prescribed setup wind-up; channel is hold-controlled,damage-interruptible,5-tile initial range.
Source has conflicting minimum-health values; art does not choose the gameplay threshold.

abilities.name: Barrier
abilities.description: Instantly bless one selected ally with a gold protective shell, visibly separate from the Cardinal.

cast.description: A compact staff blessing gesture, soft divine bell strike.

impact.description: Clear golden barrier bell with a crystalline protective shell forming.

sustain.description: Seamless very soft golden harmonic resonance, protective and still.

notes: One selected ally, not a group-wide shield; game owns round-robin selection within 8×8.
Instant application,12 s lifetime,75 HP absorption,20 percent reduction,5 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Beam
abilities.description: After one second of focus, project a straight white-gold ray that harms enemies and heals allies along its path.

cast.description: Forceful white-gold beam release, compact divine thunder with a restrained wordless harmonic edge.

impact.description: Sharp radiant contact pulse combining holy impact and a brief clear healing overtone.

charge.description: Rising white-gold divine harmonic building steadily for one second before release.

notes: Instant simultaneous damage/healing at release;1500 ms visual does not add a damage delay.
Preview boss is a demo endpoint only; ability pierces enemies and heals allies in the full line.

abilities.name: Resurrect
abilities.description: Channel for two seconds, then revive fallen allies in the area and grant the team a quiet enhanced-vision aura.

cast.description: Triumphant but compact divine release chord, warm bell and wordless choir texture.

impact.description: A bright restorative bloom with golden bells marking an ally returning to life.

charge.description: Two-second rising sacred choir-like harmonics and accumulating golden resonance.

sustain.description: Seamless quiet golden divine harmony, subtle enhanced-awareness aura.

notes: Game owns 4×4 revival selection and 50 percent restored health; wave attaches to each fallen ally.
Game owns 60 s cooldown and 15 s team telegraph enhancement; no invulnerability upgrade.
Damage interrupts the 2 s channel; no upright light columns in the overhead art.
